speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that history. To better understand the sudden onset of your abdominal pain, can you describe the exact location of the pain and what triggers it?

speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Mesenteric Ischemia. Given the history of recent myocardial infarction, sudden onset of periumbilical pain, and bloody stools, this is highly suggestive of bowel ischemia. I need to see imaging immediately to assess bowel viability. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_CT_with_contrast.
